#summary In this page, you can find the first steps in discovering Robinviz. We assume [Installation installation] has been done before performing these steps.

= Quickstart =

==Starting the program==
When robinviz starts, you can follow debug information on the terminal (black window) that is opened aside. If you encounter any freeze or problems, you can figure out the reason for that from this terminal window. If you'd like to report any problems/bugs, please include debug information you see here.

===Windows===
From Start Menu->Programs->Robinviz, click on Robinviz. A black window (terminal) and graphical user interface (GUI) of Robinviz will start.

===Linux===
Start a terminal/konsole. Change directory to robinviz installation dir and run the executable:
{{{
cd ~/robinviz
./robinviz.exe
}}}

==Running the Wizard==
Follow the File Menu->Execute path.

===Preconfigured Settings===
To have a quick run without messing with detailed configuration, you can run our preconfigured parameter settings. 
 # In the *Execution Wizard* opened, check *Use preconfigured settings* radio button
 # Select a configuration from the dropdown menu. For example you can select *PaperFigure* to see the figure we used in our paper.
 # Click on *Finish* button. Please wait for a while, this may take a few minutes. 

==Last Settings==
For some reason, if you'd like to re-run the latest configuration, 
 # Check the *Use the last settings* radio button.
 # Click on *Finish* button.

==Manual Settings==
If you want to define your own parameters for custom execution, 
 # Check *Define your manual settings* radio button
 # Click on *Next* button to follow the next steps of the wizard.

For visual examples for manual settings, follow [Manual#Sample_Input_Creation this link].
